name: Pu-erh tea
description: Tea deliberately aged and fermented for years — earthy and dark.

tcm.note: The ripened kind is warm and famously taken after fatty meals to move stagnation.

histamine.note: Years of deliberate microbial fermentation — the highest of the teas by a distance.

stimulant.note: Fermented rather than merely oxidised. Caffeine is still there; the fermentation is what raises its histamine instead.

effects.note: Trials pairing L-theanine with caffeine report calmer, steadier attention than caffeine alone — the doses studied run supplement-strength, above what one cup delivers. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
